tasks.title: Setup Project Structure
tasks.description: Create the initial project structure for the Scaffold Generator Agent with necessary dependencies and configuration files.
tasks.details:
1. Initialize a new Node.js project
2. Create the following directory structure:
```
scaffold-generator/
  ├── src/
  │   └── index.js
  ├── lib/
  ├── templates/
  ├── tests/
  └── config/
```
3. Install required dependencies:
```bash
npm init -y
npm install --save fs-extra handlebars chalk commander
npm install --save-dev jest eslint
```
4. Configure package.json with appropriate scripts:
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node src/index.js",
    "test": "jest",
    "lint": "eslint ."
  }
}
```
5. Setup basic ESLint configuration
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the project structure is created correctly by checking that all directories and files exist. Run npm test to ensure the testing framework is properly configured.
